lessons.title: 12A Reading: Urbanization
lessons.intro: Read the passage about urbanization and answer the comprehension questions. Find out what urbanization is, its causes, advantages and disadvantages, and some solutions to its problems.
lessons.introMy: မြို့ပြပြောင်းလဲမှု (urbanization) အကြောင်း စာပိုဒ်ကို ဖတ်၍ နားလည်မှုမေးခွန်းများကို ဖြေပါ။ မြို့ပြပြောင်းလဲမှုဆိုသည်မှာ အဘယ်နည်း၊ ၎င်း၏ အကြေင်းရင်းများ၊ အားသာချက်နှင့် အားနည်းချက်များ၊ ပြဿနာများကို ဖြေရှင်းနည်းများကို လေ့လာပါ။

questions.question: What is urbanization?
questions.suggested_answer: Urbanization is the process by which more and more people leave the countryside to live in cities.

questions.question: What are the causes of urbanization?
questions.suggested_answer: The causes of urbanization may be political, economic or social. The root cause is the natural desire of humans to look for greener pastures.

questions.question: What are the advantages of urbanization?
questions.suggested_answer: Urbanization brings about many advantages such as a greater number of hospitals and clinics, better equipped educational institutions, advanced infrastructure, and urban comforts and conveniences.

questions.question: What are the disadvantages of urbanization?
questions.suggested_answer: The disadvantages include the growth of slums, unemployment, overcrowded living quarters, traffic congestion, air pollution, rise in cost of living, and urban crime.

questions.question: What are some solutions to the problems of urbanization?
questions.suggested_answer: Good housing plans should be drawn up and implemented, private investments should be encouraged to create more jobs, the police force should be expanded, and means to control the influx of people should be adopted.

bonusQuestions.question: What does the phrase 'greener pastures' mean in the passage?
bonusQuestions.answer: The phrase 'greener pastures' means places that offer new opportunities.

bonusQuestions.question: What happens when modern livestock and dairy farms are established in the countryside?
bonusQuestions.answer: The rural farmers begin to find it more and more difficult to earn enough to meet their daily needs, so they move to towns or cities to find new forms of livelihood.

pre_reading.question: Where do you live - in a village, a town, or a city?
pre_reading.suggested_answer: Sample answer: I live in a city.

pre_reading.question: Why do some people leave their villages and move to towns?
pre_reading.suggested_answer: Sample answer: They move to towns for better job opportunities, education, and healthcare.

pre_reading.question: Do you think life in a city is better than life in a village?
pre_reading.suggested_answer: Sample answer: It depends on personal preferences. Cities offer more opportunities but villages offer a simpler and more peaceful life.

paragraphs.english_text: The word 'urbanization' is the noun form of the verb 'urbanize', and 'urbanize' comes from the adjective 'urban', which means 'of or in a city or town'. The simple diagram below should help you see how those three words are related. urban (adjective) → urbanize (verb) → urbanization (noun)
paragraphs.burmese_explanation: 'မြို့ပြပြောင်းလဲမှု' ဟူသော စကားလုံးသည် 'မြို့ပြပြုလုပ်သည်' ဟူသော ကြိယာ၏ နာမ်ပုံစံဖြစ်ပြီး 'မြို့ပြပြုလုပ်သည်' သည် 'မြို့ပြ' ဟူသော နာမဝိသေသနမှ ဆင်းသက်လာသည်။

paragraphs.english_text: As most of us know, people living in the countryside often leave their rural homes to live in towns and cities. This moving of rural people to towns and cities is urbanization. Thus, urbanization is 'the process by which more and more people leave the countryside to live in cities'.

Causes of urbanization. And these reasons may be political, economic or social. However, the root cause is the natural desire of humans to look for greener pastures. This means that as human beings, we wish to be better, that is we wish to get more, earn more, rise higher in rank, and so on.
paragraphs.burmese_explanation: မြို့ပြပြောင်းလဲမှု၏ အကြေင်းရင်းများ။ ဤအကြေင်းရင်းများသည် နိုင်ငံရေး၊ စီးပွားရေး သို့မဟုတ် လူမှုရေး ဖြစ်နိုင်သည်။ သို့သော် အဓိက အကြေင်းရင်းမှာ လူသားများ၏ ပိုမိုကောင်းမွန်သော နေရာများကို ရှာဖွေလိုသော သဘာဝဆန္ဒဖြစ်သည်။

paragraphs.english_text: So what do they do? They buy up land in the countryside and establish modern livestock and dairy farms. The rural farmers of that countryside begin to find it more and more difficult to earn enough to meet their daily needs. So what do they do? They move to towns or cities to find new forms of livelihood. Here, the reason is economic. Sometimes, in some parts of the world, because of war, all the people of a village are required to abandon their homes and find somewhere else to live. Here, the reason is political. The number may not be large but there are rural families who move from the countryside to towns and cities where there are better schools, colleges and universities for their children, as well as better hospitals, healthcare centres, and other medical service providers for the entire family. In such a case, the reason is social.
paragraphs.burmese_explanation: ထို့ကြောင့် ၎င်းတို့သည် အဘယ်အရာ ပြုလုပ်ကြသနည်း။ ၎င်းတို့သည် ကျေးလက်ဒေသတွင် မြေယာများကို ဝယ်ယူပြီး ခေတ်မီ မွေးမြူရေးနှင့် နို့ထွက်ပစ္စည်း စိုက်ပျိုးရေးများ တည်ထောင်ကြသည်။ ထိုကျေးလက်ဒေသရှိ ကျေးလက်လယ်သမားများသည် နေ့စဉ်လိုအပ်ချက်များကို ဖြည့်ဆည်းရန် အလွန်ခက်ခဲလာကြသည်။

paragraphs.english_text: Advantages and disadvantages. Urbanization certainly brings about many advantages such as a greater number of hospitals and clinics, all better equipped and better staffed with specialists; a greater number of educational institutions such as schools, colleges, and universities; an infrastructure more advanced than the one in the countryside; and of course, all the urban comforts and conveniences such as recreation centres, libraries, museums, parks, beauty salons, hotels, and restaurants. However, urbanization brings about many undesirable results. These may be classified as economic and social ills. One of them is the growth of slums where people live in shanties and hovels, and sanitation is inadequate. Then there are problems of unemployment, overcrowded living quarters, traffic congestion, and air pollution. There is also a rise in the cost of living, and also a rise in urban crime such as mugging, stealing, drug abusing, prostitution and murder. As a result, the urban areas are not as safe as they used to be.

Some solutions to those problems of urbanization. With more and more people from the countryside coming to stay in towns and cities, good housing plans should be drawn up and implemented. At the same time, sewage and other drainage systems should be well maintained. To solve the unemployment problem, private investments may be encouraged in order to create more jobs. The police force may need to be expanded in proportion to the increase in population and crime. Means to control the influx of people from the countryside may need to be adopted.

exercises.question: For what reasons do people living in the countryside often leave their rural homes?
exercises.answer: People leave their rural homes for political, economic or social reasons.

exercises.question: The phrase 'greener pastures' in line 9 is similar in meaning to
exercises.answer: c. places that offer new opportunities

exercises.question: When human beings wish to be better, what do they do?
exercises.answer: They switch from one job to another, move from one place to another, or give up one method and try something else.

exercises.question: When modern livestock and dairy farms are established in the countryside, what happens to the rural farmers there?
exercises.answer: They find it more and more difficult to earn enough to meet their daily needs, so they move to towns or cities.

exercises.question: Because of war in some parts of the world, what do people in villages have to do?
exercises.answer: They are required to abandon their homes and find somewhere else to live.

exercises.question: What kind of undesirable results does urbanization bring about?
exercises.answer: It brings about economic and social ills such as the growth of slums, unemployment, overcrowding, traffic congestion, air pollution, and urban crime.

exercises.question: With the growth of slums, where are people forced to live?
exercises.answer: People are forced to live in shanties and hovels where sanitation is inadequate.

exercises.question: If more job opportunities can be created, what problem can be solved?
exercises.answer: The unemployment problem can be solved.

exercises.question: To what extent should the police force be expanded?
exercises.answer: The police force should be expanded in proportion to the increase in population and crime.

exercises.question: If you were living in a village, would you move to a big city? Why?
exercises.answer: Sample answer: Yes, I would move to a big city for better education and job opportunities.

exercises.question: Would you like to live in a village or a big city? Why?
exercises.answer: Sample answer: I would like to live in a big city because it offers more opportunities and conveniences.
